name: Camping 101: Enchanting

faq.answer: Nasalanna Windsinger lives in Shen'dar Village and teaches skilled enchanters to craft special items for wilderness camps. She teaches those who prove their skill to make the Enchanted Lute.
Shen'dar Village is where Nasalanna Windsinger lives. Enchanters travel there for instruction in making campsite gear like the Enchanted Lute once they have developed their core skills.

Enchanters make the Enchanted Lute as a magical instrument for camps. It entertains companions around the campfire and restores their morale, helping travelers steel themselves for the wilderness ahead.

aliases: when can i learn enchanted lute
faq.answer: To learn how to make an Enchanted Lute, you must first prove your skill in enchanting to Nasalanna Windsinger. She trusts seasoned practitioners with this camp enchantment.
faq.q: What are the requirements to learn the recipe?

faq.answer: At wilderness camps, enchanters bring magical comforts when ordinary supplies fall short. Their enchantments help travelers recover, stay entertained, and prepare for hazards on the trail.
faq.q: Why are enchanters valuable at wilderness campsites?

faq.answer: Yes. Craftsmen and gatherers in different disciplines learn to make tools for campsites. Enchanters learn to make the Enchanted Lute from Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village.
faq.q: Can other professions craft camping items?

sections.body: On the open road, sharpened blades and rations are not enough. Travelers need rest and good spirits to endure long expeditions. Enchanters bring magical comforts to camps across Azeroth, helping weary travelers recover their strength and spirits before they return to perilous trails.
sections.title: Comforts of the Hearth

sections.body: Aspiring enchanters seeking to learn campsite magic travel to Shen'dar Village. There, Nasalanna Windsinger teaches capable spell-weavers to make an Enchanted Lute. First, they must prove their dedication and skill in enchanting. Then Nasalanna shares how to fashion an instrument whose melodies restore spirits beneath the stars.
sections.title: The Song of Shen'dar

summary: At Shen'dar Village, skilled enchanters can learn to make an Enchanted Lute for the campfire. Nasalanna Windsinger teaches them how it entertains and bolsters companions.
